.kitchen
Anda rahit bred omlet resipi | shakahari omlet | no eg omlet vistrit tasvir aur vidiyo resipi ke satha. yah shastriy anda-aadharit omlet ke lie lekin bina ande ke ek phyujan ya ek vistar resipi hai. lokapriy chikan ande-aadharit omlet ke vikalp ke rup men, yah resipi chana aata-aadharit baitar ya besan aadharit baitar se aadharit hai. besan se bane krep men paranprik ke saman banavat aur svad hota hai aur shakahariyon dvara bhi iska sevan kiya ja sakta hai.
